notes:
Primary contact: Elena Ruiz (Head of Product).

Shorthand summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building semantic search for customer-facing help and internal doc search.
- Currently using Pinecone for vector store + AWS Lambda/Glue for nightly batched embeddings (~3M vectors/day).
- Want to evaluate hosted first (low friction) then Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.
- Quote from Elena: "We need predictable pricing for our monthly batch ingest — spikes kill our budget."
- Key metrics: target query latency 30-50ms tail, 200 sustained qps for peak UI, batch import throughput >= 200k vectors/hour.
- Cost sensitivity: wants ARR-friendly pricing (aiming for < $0.005/query effective unit cost on peak).
- Security: must pass SOC2 checklist, SSO (SAML), KMS integration and data residency for EU customers.
- Integration notes: Pinecone SDK today; asked about direct integration patterns and recommended vector DB adapters, plus export/import helpers for large bulk jobs.
- Operational asks: per-route token/cost breakdown, token-level traces, and alerts for embedding quality regressions.

AE/SE notes: POC will validate batching/caching behavior with existing prefix KV patterns; SE to deliver test harness for warm cache runs.

PTP (procurement): procurement wants a 3-month cost cap for POC before approving Dedicated commitment.

Next internal milestone: procurement decision 2026-04; engineering to finalize POC scripts by 2026-03-10.
use_case_summary: SearchSprint wants embeddings-first semantic search for their product docs + customer support. Plan: import nightly batch (3M vectors/day) into Pinecone, run reranking+semantic search at 200 qps peak. Need hosted for quick proof, then move to Dedicated to control cost and latency. POC scope: validate ingest throughput, per-query 95th percentile latency (<50ms), model routing fallback when dedicated capacity saturated, and integration with their ETL (Lambda+Glue).
